thread:
maya (Support): hey team — customer (acme-corp) opened a ticket: their integration started getting 401s this morning after they moved keys into a shared spreadsheet. error from our API: "{\"error\":\"invalid_api_key\",\"message\":\"invalid key format\"}"

maya (Support): they pasted the value from Excel into their app. here's the curl they ran (redacted key ends with ...):
```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live_ABCdefGhIjKlMnOpQrsTUVwX" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings"
```

maya (Support): customer says when they copy from dashboard directly it works. when they copy from the spreadsheet it 401s. they pasted the whole cell, not the formula bar. ticket id 12345.

dennis (Eng): can you paste the raw header exported from the spreadsheet (no redaction) so we can inspect spacing/padding? also what platform (mac/win) and app (node/java)?

maya (Support): pasted (I verified with customer):
```
Authorization: Bearer sk-live_ABCdefGhIjKlMnOpQrsTUVwX
```
(note: the real key ends with "=", but the spreadsheet-copied value lost the padding)

alex (SRE): looking at auth logs for that request id from 08:12 UTC — we see: 
```
auth: token parse failed: illegal base64 data at input byte 43
auth.error_code: invalid_api_key
```
which strongly suggests base64 decode/padding error.

dennis (Eng): Excel/Sheets is notorious for trimming trailing `=` when cells are interpreted or when copy uses the displayed cell vs formula bar. Another vector is CSV import/export where some tools strip padding. Repro on my laptop:
```
# create a key-like string with padding
KEY="sk-live_ABCdefGhIjKlMnOpQrsTUVwX=="
# write to csv and open in Excel, then copy cell
printf '%s\n' "$KEY" > key.csv
# open & copy -> copied value often becomes "sk-live_ABCdefGhIjKlMnOpQrsTUVwX"
# curl with truncated key -> 401
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live_ABCdefGhIjKlMnOpQrsTUVwX" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings
# server returns 401 + invalid_api_key
```

dennis (Eng): short repro for support docs: paste key into Excel cell, then save as XLSX and re-open, copy cell (not formula bar) -> dropped '='.

maya (Support): customer confirmed they were copying cell content (not formula bar). they re-downloaded key from dashboard and it works.

alex (SRE): proposed fixes:
- quick: update support KB to call out spreadsheet/truncation and to instruct users to copy from dashboard or formula bar. :memo:
- medium: auth layer could detect likely-base64 tokens with missing padding and return a more specific error (e.g., "malformed_apikey: possible missing base64 padding") so users get actionable guidance instead of generic 401. :thinking_face:
- long: add a diagnostic field in auth logs to indicate "padding_missing=true" when base64 decode fails on final byte.

dennis (Eng): I can add the log hint and a clearer error message. Will open PR and link here. assigning to me.

maya (Support): customer rekeyed and verified. they want a KB link we can share. I'll draft the KB with repro steps and recommended copy-from-dashboard text.

ticket-bot: Ticket #12345 updated — customer confirmed fix by reissuing key; status: resolved (pending backend enhancement).

dennis (Eng): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/auth-service/pull/432 (draft) — adds padding hint and a short message change. will request review from alex.

alex (SRE): reviewed logs quickly, lgtm for diagnostic. Suggest we also add a test that simulates truncated keys so we don't regress.

maya (Support): closing the support thread after KB goes live and PR merges. thanks! :thumbsup:
